title: Thirsty for Kvasier
description: Thirsty for Kvasier — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Fah'gorn the Decembrist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Retrieve a Kavasier drink from Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell and then return it to Fah'gorn the Decembrist. Fah'gorn is in Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 off of the 3rd level of Ratsputin's Gulag.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Fah'gorn the Decembrist

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Retrieve a Kavasier drink from Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell and then return it to Fah'gorn the Decembrist. Fah'gorn is in Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 off of the 3rd level of Ratsputin's Gulag.

Offer:

Looky here, son, I'm no loud-mouthed schnook. I'm just a citizen who is concerned that is. I'm also just as thirsty as a camel in the desert without a hump. So why don't you quit being a bump on a log and make yourself of use. Get me one more of those Kavas EEE Air beverages. I can't go on whistling pete if my whistle ain't wet. I say, I say, I say. Now pay attention to me when I'm talking to you. Remember, Fah'gorn in Ratsputin's Underground Network wants Kavas EEE Air.

Go on! Quit resting on your laurels! Scoot! Skidaddle!

Turn-in:

That filled me up as much as a pebble being dropped into a boxcar. If I am to keep flapping my gums into the air about Ratsputin, I'm going to need more Kavas EEE Air.

Objectives:

  • Kvas Drink ×1

Level range: 75–95
